description: This file defines the MistralEmbedding_Embeddings class, which implements the INode interface to create a node for MistralAI embeddings. It includes methods for initializing the node with parameters and loading available models.

classes.name: MistralEmbedding_Embeddings
classes.description: A class implementing an embedding node for MistralAI, providing configuration and initialization logic.

methods.description: Asynchronously loads available models for embeddings from the model loader.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MistralAI embedding model with parameters from node data and credentials.
